stories.name: Cloud Security & Identity Partnerships
stories.blurb: A roundup of vendor announcements and market growth around cloud security, identity verification, and data protection solutions tied to the Microsoft ecosystem.

stories.name: Microsoft Earnings Optimism
stories.blurb: Analysts and investors express strong bullish sentiment on Microsoft stock ahead of and following its July 29 earnings report, predicting significant gains.

stories.name: Meta's AI Cloud Push

stories.blurb: Investors and credit markets are increasingly scrutinizing whether the massive, escalating capital expenditures by Microsoft and other hyperscalers on AI infrastructure are financially sustainable.

stories.name: Amazon stock outlook

stories.name: AI Safety and Rivalry

stories.name: Enterprise Software Stock Valuations

stories.name: Salesforce stock rally
stories.blurb: A series of headlines tracking Salesforce's stock surge, AI-driven growth prospects, and whether the rally can continue.

past.name: Microsoft Xbox Layoffs
past.blurb: Microsoft is cutting thousands of jobs, with the Xbox gaming division hit hardest as the company restructures its game studios and workforce.

past.name: AI Infrastructure Boom
